typography.font_family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif

surface_treatment_rules.rule_1_standard_card: Use #1C1C1E with 1px border border_subtle and rounded-2xl (16px) for standard grouping blocks.
surface_treatment_rules.rule_2_gold_card: Reserve gold borders and gold subtles strictly for high-value AI / 'Ask Jessi' / 'Deal Status' highlights. Max 1 gold card visible on screen at any time to avoid visual competition.
surface_treatment_rules.rule_3_flat_rows: Inside cards or lists, use flat 1px subtle divider lines instead of nesting cards inside cards.
surface_treatment_rules.rule_4_header_glass: Header and bottom composer use blur background rgba(28,28,30,0.85) with backdrop-filter blur(20px) and bottom/top border rgba(255,255,255,0.1).

layout_architecture.screen: Contact Detail Screen (/app/frontend/app/contact/[id].tsx or component tree)

top_to_bottom_blueprint.description: Sticky top bar with back navigation, contact name title, open in Inbox icon, and Edit trigger.

Unified Hero Card: Clean avatar + Touchpoint counter pill, Contact full name (22px bold), Gold Vehicle Badge tag, location/occupation/relationship duration meta line, clean 4-stat metrics row (Touchpoints, Messages, Clicks, Campaigns), and organized metadata pills (Tags, Dates, Active Campaigns) separated by category.
Integrated Health Pill (Opportunity/Advocate/Warm/Cooling/Cold) with subtle color-coded dot and last engagement timestamp.
5 primary actions: Call, Text (scrolls to composer), Voice Note/Record, Add Task, Mark Sold (Gold accent). Replaced duplicate email with voice note.
Up Next Action Card: Display active open tasks for this contact or 'No pending tasks' with '+ Add Task' quick button.
Merged Jessi Briefing Teaser & 'Ask Jessi' prompt into one cohesive AI Intelligence Card. Shows 1 key insight line with expandable full briefing + instant Ask Jessi search bar.
Segmented tab bar: [Details] [Calls] [Feed]. Sticky below hero/AI cards.

sub_tabs.Details: Clean list grouping: 1. Action Progress Tracker, 2. Personal Intelligence Facts, 3. Vehicle & Purchase History, 4. Important Dates & Opt-ins, 5. Campaign Enrollments, 6. Share & CRM Export.
sub_tabs.Calls: List of recorded calls & voice notes with audio waveform playback, transcription toggle, and summary notes.
sub_tabs.Feed: Chronological searchable timeline of all touchpoints (SMS, calls, cards, AI triggers) with date grouping and filter pills.

top_to_bottom_blueprint.description: Bottom fixed bar with SMS/Email mode selector, smart suggestion sparkle button, text input, quick media/card attachments toggle, and primary send button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='quick-action-call-button', data-testid='tab-details', data-testid='composer-send-button').
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays that have content scrolling under them.
Do NOT introduce duplicate email or text buttons across the hero and quick actions; keep quick actions focused on direct actions (Call, Text, Record, Task, Sold).
Maintain the dark theme palette (#000000 base, #1C1C1E surface, #C9A962 gold accent) strictly.
Ensure responsive layout optimization for mobile web viewports with comfortable touch targets (minimum 44x44px).
Use smooth micro-interactions (collapsible sections with chevron indicators, active tab indicator transitions, micro scale feedback on tap).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All buttons, inputs, tab items, cards, and interactive controls must have data-testid.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never set background to transparent on floating/fixed headers, dropdowns, or modals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_rhythm: Use 12px-16px gap between stacked sections, 14px-16px internal card padding.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.gold_accent_usage: Use gold (#C9A962) strictly for high-value actions (Mark Sold, Ask Jessi primary, Vehicle model tag).
